disclosures.text: A gantry includes a main body
Two side branches extend downward from the main body
Side branches are supported on a pair of side caterpillar tracks
A pair of adjustable clamps, each with a pair of clamp arms
Clamp arms are configured to hold a rail
Two first hydraulic cylinders interconnect clamp arms to close onto a rail web
Two vertical support rods extend vertically through the main body
Lower end of each rod supports one adjustable clamp
Upper end of each rod includes a screw threaded portion
Upper end of each rod includes a nut
Upper end of each rod includes a counter locking nut
Screw threaded portion, nut, and counter locking nut form a mechanism for vertical adjustment of the clamp
Two second hydraulic cylinders have one end attached to a vertical support rod
Other end of second hydraulic cylinders attached to one of the side branches
Second hydraulic cylinders laterally adjust the vertical support rod and adjustable clamp

A machine for unloading and positioning a plurality of rails on a plurality of crossties in railway tracks, comprising: a gantry including a main body; two side branches extending downwardly from the main body and supported on a pair of sid
Each adjustable clamp is connected to a vertical support rod through a deformable parallelogram
Deformable parallelogram is actuated by an elevation hydraulic cylinder
Deformable parallelogram maintains the adjustable clamp in a horizontal arrangement regardless of height
Side branches are located outside of the crossties
Caterpillar tracks are configured to move on a track ballast
Protective plates are provided to cover the caterpillar tracks
Second hydraulic cylinders adjust clamps to different track gauges
Adjustable clamps unload rails from a rail transport vehicle
Adjustable clamps deposit rails on a railway track in correctly aligned positions
Rail transport vehicle is a rail carrier train
